notes.title: Free DLC "Owl Rescue" release date and more!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Are you ready for a new adventure?

Over last week, I've been listening closely to your feedback, and that affected the way I approach the game's forthcoming content.

Very soon the game will feature new mode called "Adventures", an individual mini-campaigns. And I'm happy to announce that the first adventure, upcoming free DLC "Owl Rescue", is scheduled to launch on September 30, 2016. 

http://store.steampowered.com//app/533870
Owl Rescue will feature 50 all-new facts with explanations and better difficulty curve, and it will be available to all players for free.

But that's not all.

For those who owns the Expansion Pack, the long wait is finally over! It took me a bit of work, and starting today contents of Expansion Pack are also available in the Campaign mode, increasing number of facts available in Campaign to 700. Have fun, and if you have enjoyed the Expansion Pack, please leave a review on it.

One more thing - a new video by Jack Septic Eye:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dv2Pf3ESztU
That's it for now. Hope you all have a fantastic weekend!
